summary: Fix a flaky member-reconciliation deadline test whose 10ms per-repository budget also expired the master list and later TLS POST under CI load. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Test-only timing correction; no operator behavior changed.

api.reason: API impact: none. Test-only change; the member access POST contract, per-repository deadline and the transport's refusal to send an already-expired request are unchanged.

roadmap.reason: CI reliability fix within the current storage milestone.

state.reason: No durable state, setting or execution authority added or changed.

verification.method: Before: temporarily logging the reconcile error, 32 parallel race-built instances at GOMAXPROCS=1 with -test.count=20 failed 256 of 640 runs (174 master-list deadline, 7 local-observation/list deadline, 67 later-POST deadline) and reported 32 data races from late master handler writes; the fake for the first repository never ran in the line-806 failures. After raising the test budget to 1s: the same stress at -test.cpu=1,2 passed 1280 of 1280 with zero races; gofmt, go vet, GOMAXPROCS=2 go test ./internal/agent and go test -race ./internal/agent passed. Both GitHub and Gitea phase1 workflows already run go test -race ./...
